title.tr: Yan yana dizilmiş bal rengi ahşap tahtalar
title.en: Honey-coloured timber boards laid side by side

alt.tr: Birbirine sıkı oturan, bal rengi ve ince damarlı ahşap tahtaların yakın çekimi
alt.en: Close-up of tightly fitted honey-coloured timber boards with fine grain

caption.tr: Tahtalar yan yana düz bir hatta sıralanmış. Yüzey düzgün zımparalanmış ve damar ince.
caption.en: The boards sit in a straight line side by side. The surface is smoothly sanded and the grain is fine.
